player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ Stratego.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛfa wo opponent Flag anaa wo asiw wo opponent pieces nyinaa.
Wo asraafo edzi wo wɔ board no so, a ne Flag, Bombs, ne pieces afoforɔ a wɔn rank yɛ soronko.

### Gameplay Instructions
1. **Movement Rules:**
   - Wɔ wo turn, wo tumi fa piece baako kɔ mu kɔ square a ɛbɛn (soro, asase, kɔn anaa benkum) a wɔde wo pieces ahyɛ mu.
   - Example: Piece bi tumi fa A1 kɔ B1 anaa A1 kɔ A2 sɛ B1 ne A2 nni wo pieces ankasa.
   - Sɛ wo piece a wo pɛ ne Bomb anaa Flag, wo ntumi nfa.
2. **Battles:**
   - Sɛ wo kɔ square a opponent piece bi wɔ, na battle bɛkɔ so:
     - Piece a ne rank yɛ kɛse no di nkunim.
     - Sɛ ranks no yɛ pɛ, pieces no nyinaa bɛyɛ kɔ.
     - **Special Cases:**
       - Bombs siw pieces aforɔ a wɔreto nkyɛn, gye Miners, a wɔde Bombs no bɔ.
       - Spies tumi di nkunim wɔ Marshal sɛ Spy no to kɔn, nanso wɔpɛ wɔ pieces afoforɔ.
3. **Strategic Goals:**
   - Hwɛ wo opponent pieces fa wɔn movements ne battles.
   - Bɔ wo Flag wɔ ase wɔrekɔ so sɛ wo bɛfa wo opponent Flag.
   - Fa Scouts so sɛ wo bɛnya wo opponent pieces ho nsɛm ne wɔn pieces a wɔyɛ mmerɛ.

### How to Make a Move:
1. Kyerɛ coordinates a wo piece bi wɔ ne ne destination.
2. Fa format yi: [A0 B0], a A0 ne source position, na B0 ne destination.
   - Example: Sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo fa piece bi fi row 0, column 0 kɔ row 1, column 0, input [A0 B0].
3. Hwɛ sɛ destination no yɛ valid sɛ wɔ movement rules a ɛwɔ soro.

### Important Notes:
- Board no bɛkyerɛ wo pieces ne wɔn positions, e.g. MN, MS.
- Board no bɛkyerɛ wo opponent pieces positions a wɔnim, e.g. ?.
- Grids a ~ wɔ no yɛ lakes, na wo ntumi nkɔ mu.
- Sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ, fa wo game ase sɛ wo bɛfa wo pieces a wɔwɔ front lines kɔ so sɛ wo bɛnya wo opponent pieces ho nsɛm. Player 0 ne player 1 frontlines yɛ row D ne G, sɛnea ɛte biara.
